in_sanskrit.name: चिनामिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chinarika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chintamani', which means 'wish-fulfilling' or 'beloved of the Goddess'. The suffix '-ika' means 'beloved of'. So, Chinarika can be translated as 'Beloved of the Goddess Cintamani'.

in_hindi.name: चिनामिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chinarika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chintamani', which is 'चिन्तामणी' in Hindi. The suffix '-ika' means 'beloved of'. So, Chinarika can be translated as 'Beloved of the Goddess Cintamani' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: சினாமிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chinarika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chintamani'. In Tamil, 'சிந்தோர்' (Cintamani) means 'wish-fulfilling' or 'beloved of the Goddess', and 'கள்ளூர்' (Kal yoor) means 'beloved of'. So, Chinarika can be translated as 'Beloved of the Goddess Cintamani' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: చినామిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chinarika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chintamani'. In Telugu, 'చిన్తమాని' (Chintamani) means 'wish-fulfilling' or 'beloved of the Goddess', and 'కేశోదరి' (Kesodari) means 'beloved of'. So, Chinarika can be translated as 'Beloved of the Goddess Cintamani' in Telugu.
